Privacy Policy

How this website handles your information and how to contact AutixAI about it.

Updated 7 October 2026

Information you choose to share

The enquiry form asks for your name, business, industry, phone and the process you want to automate. Email, team size, time spent and current tools are optional. We use information you send to respond to your request, prepare an audit and discuss a possible project. Please do not include passwords, payment details or confidential business records in an initial enquiry.

A draft first. You choose when to send.

Preparing a request builds a message in your browser. No form details are sent to an AutixAI backend or saved in browser storage by this website. Opening WhatsApp passes the draft to WhatsApp; you review it and tap Send there to contact us. If you leave or reload the page, the website does not deliberately retain a copy of your inputs.

If a direct enquiry service is connected later, this page and the form notice will describe it. A separate, explicit send button will be required after you review the draft.

AutixAI guided assistant

The floating assistant uses pre-written conversational branches and the services, industries and examples published on this website. It does not use a live AI model. Messages, selections and audit details are processed in your browser and kept only in the open page’s memory. Closing the panel keeps your conversation available in that page; Reset, reloading, navigating to another page or closing the tab clears it. The assistant does not save conversation history in browser storage or send it to an AI provider or chat backend.

Requesting an audit prepares a local draft using your selected business type, process and tools, plus the name, business and WhatsApp number or email you enter. The summary contains selected workflow context, not the full chat. You can edit or remove it and review the exact draft before opening WhatsApp. Opening the link passes the draft to WhatsApp; you must tap Send there to contact AutixAI. Please do not share passwords, API keys or sensitive personal information in the assistant.

Calculator, demos and analytics

The calculator and workflow simulations run locally in the page. They do not connect to your business tools. The website currently sets no analytics cookies, uses no advertising tracker and does not transmit analytics events. Optional analytics hooks, including assistant interaction events, are inactive by default. They accept fixed event names only, without messages, selected business details or contact values; the notice must be updated before any analytics service is activated.

Hosting and services you open

Vercel hosts the website and may process normal request information, including IP addresses and logs, under its Privacy Notice. WhatsApp applies its own privacy policies. If a calendar link is configured, opening it takes you to that booking provider. These services have their own data handling practices. Fonts and website media are hosted with the site.

Contact and deletion requests

For questions, corrections or deletion requests concerning information you sent to AutixAI, contact us on +91 96173 10042 or WhatsApp. Tell us which enquiry you mean without sending extra sensitive information. We will review the request and explain any information we need to keep for an active project, business records or an applicable obligation. Requests concerning a third-party service’s own records should be directed to that service.

Changes

We will update this page when website features or information handling change. The date above identifies this version. Project-specific data handling and provider choices are agreed separately in the project scope.
